definitions.explanation: Additional payment given to employees beyond regular salary, typically twice a year.

examples.english: The summer bonus was paid out.

examples.japanese: {賞与|しょうよ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧2⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧、⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧2⟦か{月|げつ}→か月：00956_kagetsu⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Bonuses are paid twice a year, equivalent to two months' salary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{賞与|しょうよ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The bonus amount varies depending on company performance.

examples.japanese: {賞与|しょうよ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new computer with my bonus.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{賞与|しょうよ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone is worried after hearing that there might not be a bonus this year.

notes:
{賞与|しょうよ} is a more formal term than ⟦ボーナス→ボーナス：05878_boonasu⟧, often used in official documents.

SEASONAL BONUSES IN JAPAN:
- ⟦{夏季|かき}→夏季：12102_kaki⟧{賞与|しょうよ} (summer bonus - around July)
- ⟦{冬季|とうき}→冬季：11755_touki⟧{賞与|しょうよ} or ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧{賞与|しょうよ} (winter/year-end bonus - around December)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賞与|しょうよ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (bonus is paid)
- {賞与|しょうよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支給|しきゅう}する→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧ (to pay out bonus)
- {賞与|しょうよ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{査定|さてい}→査定：07518_satei⟧ (bonus evaluation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ボーナス→ボーナス：05878_boonasu⟧ (bonus - more casual, commonly used in speech)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, bonuses are considered part of standard compensation. Many employees plan major purchases around bonus season.
